Description
The University of Sunderland has campuses in both Sunderland and Hong Kong and partners with some of the world's largest organizations such as Microsoft, Yahoo!, Nissan and Proctor & Gamble. University of Sunderland is ranked 27th in the UK for Law and the subject is one of the highest climbers in recent years in the Guardian University Guide. It is also ranked 9th (out of 131 universities) in the ‘Student Support’ category of the Whatuni Student Choice Awards 2019, international students are well looked after.
ONCAMPUS Sunderland provides pathways leading to guaranteed progression to the University of Sunderland on successful completion of the Foundation program.
